The three plots expand to 200x200 about their own bedrock and their union is X97500..97699 Z80300..80899 - exactly 200x600, so the anchor is forced and there is no slack on any edge. The previous value [97500, 203, 80349] put U599 forty-nine blocks past the last plot.

modules.name: Signal Heron
modules.resized_note: 52 x 45 reached U218 - four columns into the Midway, overlapping Arrival Court by 152 cells, and crossing both midway walk 1 and the U213 threshold. THE BIRD MEASURES 14 x 32. The garden is sized to the sculpture plus a viewing margin, which is what it was always meant to be, and it now sits inside the Claim Line reach it is sited on.

modules.name: Mining Square
modules.resized_note: 56 deep ran V78-133: through the back promenade and 184 cells into the Assay office, including the cell that is Assay's own front door. Frontier B owes 53 + 56 = 109 into a 97-deep column. At 41 the column reads Boomtown V24-76 (53) + a 3-wide walk V77-79 + Mining Square V80-120 (41) = EXACTLY 97, and its front door then addresses a real street instead of the back of Boomtown Spine. It is an open square, not a building.

modules.name: Works Yard
modules.resized_note: 18 deep from V157 reached V174 - across the rim edge and four courses into the protected reserve V170-199. The service band is EXACTLY 18 (V152-169) and the service lane takes V154-156, so 13 is all there is behind it: a lane inside the band and an 18-deep yard behind the lane cannot both exist. It gains 5 of width instead, which the band has.

modules.name: Carousel Court
modules.resized_note: the RIDE alone, not the court - Jack kept the merry-go-round and threw the plazas, queues, booths and benches around it away

modules.name: Sky Lift
modules.resized_note: the WHEEL alone; 19 deep as built, 22 declared for its own clearance

modules.name: Wyrm's Crossing
modules.resized_note: THE SKULL IS THE 54x66x40 REFERENCE AT FULL RESOLUTION. Halving it turns every curve into a two-block step and thirding it is worse - that is what read as flat. The Prism Reach is U385-429, forty-five columns, so a 44-wide module only fits starting at U385, and the whole `bone_ruins` library build (105x111) cannot fit here at any resolution that keeps its detail. The skull is the part that reads.

build_notes.budget_policy: 78-86% cheap structure/detail; 10-16% okay accents; 2-5% declared functional expensive; no decorative terracotta/concrete/quartz/glass bulk
build_notes.budget_note: 265,000 was the visual spec's programme. The transit railway is five segments the spec never costed - Jack: 'our transportation railway which made sense is completely gone' - so the target carries them rather than a reserve meant for review-led detail paying for them.
